title: NHK Web やさしい日本語 — 電車とバスの乗り方 (Using Trains and Buses in Japan)
description: From NHK Web やさしい日本語. A practical guide to Japanese public transport: buying tickets, using IC cards (Suica / PASMO), reading route maps, platform announcements, and asking for directions at a station. Includes key phrases for when trains are delayed or cancelled.
creator: NHK (日本放送協会)
